_notes.roleSeparation: No address may appear in both `recyclers` and `auditors`. RECYCLER produces reports, AUDITOR authorises the payout; one key holding both is the treasury-drain path of docs/plan/security-audit-remediation.md section 3.1. script/ManageRoles.s.sol aborts if this file violates the rule, and addresses in `admins`/`emergency` must not appear in either operational list.
_notes.fundWallets: ADVISORY ONLY. `recyclerFunds`/`auditorFunds` record the wallet each principal is expected to register; no script applies them. `RecyReport.setFundsWallet(address)` is self-service, so each principal must call it from its own key.
_notes.unlockDelay: 3600 on the local dev chain (the on-chain minimum: the Phase 2 implementation enforces MIN_UNLOCK_DELAY = 1 hour at BOTH initialize and setUnlockDelay, so 60 is no longer deployable). Local claim flows warp time anyway - script/PopulateRecyReport.s.sol warps unlockDelay + 300 automatically. Public networks use 86400.

_notes.roleSplit: Phase 0 of the security remediation. Four principals held RECYCLER+AUDITOR live (0x3402ce3b, 0x5f3CD352, 0xF62DaAe4 and the factory 0x957C90a7); this file previously understated that by listing 0xF62DaAe4 under admins/emergency only. Admin keys (0x3402ce3b, 0xF62DaAe4) and the factory now hold no operational role at all; 0x5f3CD352 keeps RECYCLER and loses AUDITOR. Rationale in docs/plan/remediation-runbook.md.
_notes.notInAnyList: 0xF62DaAe4c3f9Fadf689F767716a82dFEe5026C89 and the factory 0x957C90a7E568349005772072Cb75C3dfd3460B51 hold RECYCLER+AUDITOR on chain but appear in no operational list here. Both revocations are in the runbook; `ManageRoles.checkSeparationOnChain()` audits them.
_notes.fundWallets: ADVISORY ONLY. `recyclerFunds`/`auditorFunds` record the wallet each principal is expected to register; no script applies them. After the Phase 2 upgrade `RecyReport.setFundsWallet(address)` is self-service, so each principal must call it from its own key. `RecyReportFactory.setRecyclerFund`/`setAuditorFund` revert after that upgrade.
_notes.blessedAddresses: `contracts.reportImplementation` and `contracts.reportData` are the blessed pair. script/deploy/RecyReportProxyDeploy.s.sol asserts the factory's immutables match them and aborts otherwise (security-audit-remediation.md section 5a). Update both entries as Phase 1 and Phase 2 land.
_notes.unlockDelay: Raised 60 -> 86400 (24h). This value only governs NEW proxies deployed through the factory. The live proxy keeps 60s until the Phase 2 upgrade ships setUnlockDelay(uint64), after which an admin must call setUnlockDelay(86400).
